subject: im
question: Define cost slope.
title: Rupees Per Day Saved
hook: Walk is free but slow. Taxi is quick but costly. The slope is the price of one saved day.
answer: Cost slope = increase in direct cost per unit decrease in time when an activity is crashed.
Formula: (crash cost - normal cost) / (normal time - crash time).
Example: normal 10 days Rs 1000, crash 6 days Rs 1800: slope = 800 / 4 = Rs 200 per day.
The activity with the lowest slope is crashed first.
